title: Karvest
tagline: Programmatic harvesting of lending and staking rewards and their herding to stablecoins or reinvestment as a fierce bull
description: In the pasture of DeFi, Karvest ensures that not a single payday goes amiss. Programmatically it cowllects your rewards from lending and staking protocols. The rewards are then herded as stablecoins in your vault, or restaked as a fierce bull.  For example, Gnosis token obtained from staking can be monthly collected and restaked.
how_its_made:
The project primarily uses Cowswap hooks, programmatic orders and safe fullback functionalities Their combination for regular payout in a functional demo is a particularly technical hack. 
Among the steps, a smart contract is deployed to prepare for the orders, authorization for claiming the tokens given, swap orders are emitted.. 
The interface takes the form of a react safe app that can be used from a safe vault.
